mapper.select: select JOB_POSTS_IDX, TITLE, TECH_STACK, POSTS_CREATED_AT from JOB_POSTS where COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx};
SELECT COMPANY_IDX FROM job_posts WHERE JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} LIMIT 1

SELECT JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, TITLE AS title, TECH_STACK AS techStack, CAREER AS career, EDUCATION AS education, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType, SALARY AS salary, COMPANY_IDX AS companyIdx FROM job_posts WHERE JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} LIMIT 1

SELECT ca.COMPANY_APPLICANT_IDX AS companyApplicantIdx, cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX AS coverPostsIdx, ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, CAST(cp.HOPE_JOB AS CHAR) AS hopeJob, CAST(cp.HOPE_REGION AS CHAR) AS hopeRegion, CAST(cp.EDUCATION AS CHAR) AS education, CAST(cp.CAREER AS CHAR) AS career, cp.KEYSKILL AS keyskill, cp.APPLY_MOTIVE AS applyMotive, cp.GROWTH_PROCESS AS growthProcess, cp.PERSONALITY AS personality, cp.JOB_EXPERIENCE AS jobExperience FROM cover_posts cp JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN company_applicant ca ON ca.COVER_POSTS_IDX = cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX AND ca.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} ORDER BY cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_matching ( COM_MATCH_SCORE, COM_AI_REASON, MATCHING_CREATEAT, JOBSEEKER_IDX, COMPANY_IDX, JOB_POSTS_IDX ) VALUES ( #{matchRate}, #{reason}, SYSDATE(), #{jobseekersIdx}, #{companyIdx}, #{jobPostsIdx} )
